blocked_sentences: {3}{R}: This creature deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets. Activate only if this creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.

needs.what: `damage` with `divided` inside an activated ability's effects, with the division announced at activation over the targets just declared (602.2b applying 601.2d), over an ability-level target spec of 'one or two targets' (count 2, min_count 1) capped at one target per point of damage
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `damage.divided` exists, but `loader._check_division_homes` refuses it anywhere but a top-level spell effect ('divided damage is only supported as a top-level effect of a spell'), because `Game._ask_damage_division` is only called from `Game._cast` and `engine.division.divided_damage` reads only `card.spell_effects`. The activation path's `Game._ask_distribution` divides only `distribute_counters`, not damage; two fixed `damage` effects of 1 each would fix the split and the target count, an approximation

needs.what: damage `divided` over a target spec of kind "any" (creatures, planeswalkers, battles AND players), so the 601.2d announcement offers players a share and resolution deals each player target its share
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `Game._ask_damage_division` keeps only declared refs with `kind == "object"` and `ops_life._damage_divided` deals each share through `damage_permanent`, so a player chosen as one of the targets would receive no damage; restricting to permanents would be an approximation
